schedule: always-on daemon (FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:8774) started by the stream watchdog like the other cluster servers
notes: Server-cluster config area (python -m server_cluster.config; added 2026-11): a READ-ONLY configuration server — the UI API reads configuration over HTTP instead of from disk/DB. GET /catalog serves the service catalog (MONITORED_SERVICES + the database/sql/monitoring/static/service_config tree + per-area residents — the data formerly hand-mirrored in data_viz monitor _shared.ts SERVICE_CATALOG), GET /orchestration + /orchestration/{file} serve the scripts/orchestration step files, GET /cluster serves the areas/ports/residents/lifecycle topology from DEFAULT_AREAS + cluster_config.json, GET /health and /stats the standard liveness. Serves its own lean app (no jobs surface, no residents), like the llm area. One instance only — the registration guard auto-exits a second run.
